+title: Point the remaining private event-stream `collect` copies at the shared test helper
+---
+## What
+Card ^0e1ajzv moved `collect(_:)` and `collectEvents(_:prompt:)` into `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers/SessionEventCollection.swift` as internal free functions, and made `AutoCompactionTests` and `ToolInvocationLivenessTests` call them. Four other suites still hold their own private copy of the same loop, and one doc comment names the now-deleted `AutoCompactionTests.collect(_:)`.
+
+Files:
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/SessionEventStreamTests.swift`: private `collect(_ stream: AsyncThrowingStream<SessionEvent, Error>)`.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/GuidedGenerationTests.swift`: private `collect(_ stream: AsyncThrowingStream<SessionEvent, Error>)`. Its doc line says "mirrors `AutoCompactionTests.collect(_:)`", which no longer exists.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/DiscoveryPrimingTests.swift`: private `collect(_ stream: AsyncThrowingStream<SessionEvent, Error>)` and a private `collect(_ stream: AsyncStream<SessionEvent>)`.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/PromptQueueTests.swift`: private `collect(_ stream: AsyncStream<SessionEvent>)`.
+
+Delete each throwing-stream copy and call the shared `collect(_:)`. For the two `AsyncStream<SessionEvent>` copies, add one shared non-throwing overload to `SessionEventCollection.swift` and call it from both files.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No test file under `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests` declares its own `collect(_:)` over `SessionEvent` streams; every drain goes through `SessionEventCollection.swift`.
+- [ ] No doc comment names `AutoCompactionTests.collect(_:)`.
+- [ ] `swift build 2>&1` and `swift test 2>&1` are green with zero warnings from this repository.
+
+#tests #reuse
\ No newline at end of file
